header.title: ScrambleText
header.description: Matrix-style decode for titles, labels and metrics: the characters start scrambled and resolve from left to right. Pass the copy with `text` or as children. `decode` runs once; `loop` repeats after `hold`. It starts on mount by default.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. It starts with `loop` so you can see the effect without reloading; with `decode` and `always` it runs once every time a prop changes.

base.title: Basic decode
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="decode"`, `trigger="always"`, `duration={900}`) the copy scrambles on mount and resolves once. The root is a `span` with gem-system's mono font and tabular numbers so the width doesn't jump. Only spaces, tabs and line breaks are kept: punctuation gets scrambled too.

heading.title: In a heading
heading.description: Since the root is a `span`, you can drop it straight into an `h2`, a `p` or a link without breaking the HTML. Screen readers read the real copy from a visually hidden copy, not the glyphs.

texts.title: WELCOME
texts.caption: The effect sits inside the h2.

loop.title: Looping
loop.description: `variant="loop"` scrambles again after a pause. `hold` is how long the copy stays resolved between rounds, in milliseconds.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover`, it decodes again every time the pointer enters, and shows the final copy when it leaves. With `click`, one click starts the effect and the next one stops it and shows the final copy; with `decode` it takes two clicks to replay.

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: `charset` sets where the replacement glyphs come from. By default it's ASCII letters and digits; an empty string falls back to the default.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: With a digits `charset` and tabular numbers, it works well for dashboards. `number` children also work as copy.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` doesn't change how many characters are scrambled but how often they change: about `18`, `28` or `42` times per second. With a number between `0` and `1` the minimum is `8`.

duration.title: Duration and delay
duration.description: `duration` is how long it takes for the whole copy to resolve, in milliseconds. `delay` waits before the first decode while showing already scrambled glyphs, so the final copy is never revealed early. With `loop`, `delay` only applies to the first round: the next ones wait for `hold`.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the single child without adding a `span`, and the glyphs replace its content. If you omit `text`, the source copy comes from the child's own content, and the button keeps its accessible name. Here with `trigger="hover"` on a button.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the glyphs as they are and, when unpaused, resumes from the same point: paused time doesn't count. `isDisabled` shows the copy without scrambling.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onScrambleText` fires when the effect turns on (on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or on click with `click`) and `outScrambleText` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. Click the copy to turn it on and off.

header.title: ScrambleText API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `ScrambleText`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/scramble-text` with its `scramble-text.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes and passes them to the root span (or to the child, with asChild), aria-label included. onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the final copy is shown right away, without scrambling. The preference is listened to live: if it changes while the effect runs, it applies immediately.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the scramble. Only use it when essential.
items.name: The glyphs are aria-hidden and the real copy goes in a visually hidden span (.gemfx-scramble-text__sr), so screen readers read it as regular content, also inside a heading or a button with asChild.
items.width: The mono font and tabular numbers keep the copy from changing width while scrambling. If you switch to a proportional font, the layout may jump.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover" or "click" the effect only responds to the pointer: keyboard focus doesn't start it. Don't use it to convey information.

items.root: Root (`span`). `position: relative`, `inline-flex`, `max-width: 100%`, `font-family: var(--gem-font-mono)`, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and `color: inherit`.
items.variant: Active variant. It has no styles of its own.
items.trigger: Active trigger, while the effect is enabled. Sets `cursor: pointer`.
items.on: Added while the effect is on with `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. It has no styles of its own.
items.surface: `span` that wraps the glyphs (`z-index: 1`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.
items.glyphs: The `span` with the visible characters (`aria-hidden`, `white-space: pre-wrap`).
items.sr: Visually hidden copy of the real text, read by screen readers.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They're written inline on every render, but no CSS rule uses them: the animation runs in JavaScript.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables ScrambleText reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which copy gets scrambled and where the effect is mounted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pattern, replacement glyphs and change rate.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Duration, delay and pause between rounds, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it runs, how it pauses and how it turns off.

items.text: Copy to scramble. Wins over the children's text. Keeps spaces and line breaks.
items.children: Source copy when `text` is omitted: the plain text of the children is used (strings, numbers and the content of nested elements).
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `span`, and replaces its content with the glyphs. Without `text`, it uses the child's own text.
items.variant: `decode` runs once and keeps the copy; `loop` repeats after `hold`.
items.charset: Replacement characters. An empty (or whitespace-only) string falls back to the default: ASCII letters and digits.
items.intensity: Glyph change rate (`18`, `28` or `42` per second). Token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Time until the whole copy is resolved. Negative values are treated as `0` (no scramble).
items.delay: Wait before the first decode, showing scrambled glyphs. With `loop`, it only applies to the first round.
items.hold: Pause with the copy resolved before the next round. Only with `variant="loop"`.
items.trigger: `always` starts on mount, `hover` decodes every time the pointer enters and `click` turns on and off with each click.
items.isActive: Lets the effect run. When `false` it shows the final copy and `outScrambleText` receives `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the current glyphs. When unpaused it resumes from the same point; paused time doesn't count.
items.isDisabled: Shows the copy without scrambling. `outScrambleText` receives `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Scrambles even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onScrambleText: Fires when the effect turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter with `hover` or on click with `click`.
items.outScrambleText: Fires when it turns off: on pointer leave, on a second click, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-scramble-text-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `span`, or the child with `asChild`).
